objective: On triangular tori of fresh sizes and on planar patches, classify every complement-closed fair contact with three hidden places as locally contradicting, frozen, or contradicting only through the twist; measure how the contradiction rate depends on the twist; and measure the winding classes of minimal contradictions in the twist-only class.
status: Closed: supported by TRIPLE-TWIST-20261023-001B-E001 (frozen contract; 120 complement-closed placements on planar patches of radius 4 and 6 and on 4x6, 6x4, 6x6, 7x7 and sheared 5x7 triangular tori in four twists; 160 s). Controls pass: the solver matches brute force, the lattice code is right, a contractible seam is a gauge for complement-closed contacts (300 of 300) and a defect for x or 1-in-3 (0 to 201 of 300). Every placement has exactly one certificate: 66 contradict on planar patches (local, as scoped) and 54 tile with doubly allowed patterns. No tiling placement contradicts on a patch or in a fitting twist, and all 7481 minimal contradictions wind (5150 lines, 2331 crosses). For all 20 scoped placements the twists split on every torus and every non-fitting twist contradicts. 1971 line contradictions arise in placements that are neither pair nor parity worlds, and all 1746 lines on tori with one fitting twist run along classes the relative twist makes odd. The independent checker recomputed 960 doubly allowed assignments and replayed 66 local certificates, 12 tiling patches and 45 minimal contradictions.
title: Experiment: the census of twisted three-place contacts
